# Xoft Tools — Free AI Tools & Online Calculators

> Xoft Tools (websiteads.vercel.app) offers free browser-based tools and calculators for creators, students, freelancers, and small businesses in the USA. No sign-up and no paywall. Every calculation runs locally in the visitor's own browser — inputs are never sent to a server.

## Calculators

- [50/30/20 Budget Calculator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/calculators/50-30-20-budget-calculator.html): Split monthly income into needs, wants, and savings with the classic 50/30/20 rule, with worked examples and adjustments for high-cost cities.
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/calculators/savings-goal-calculator.html): See how many months it takes to reach a savings goal with monthly deposits and compound interest.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/calculators/loan-emi-calculator.html): Exact monthly payment, total interest, and a year-by-year payoff summary before borrowing.
- [Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/calculators/freelance-rate-calculator.html): Hourly and day rates from a target income, adjusted for taxes, platform fees, billable hours, and time off.
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/calculators/profit-margin-calculator.html): Gross profit margin, markup, and break-even point for small businesses and online sellers.

## AI and creator tools

- [AI Video Prompt Generator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/tools/ai-prompt-generator.html): Turn a topic into a structured, cinematic AI video prompt for Shorts, TikTok, and Reels.
- [YouTube Hook & Title Generator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/tools/youtube-hook-generator.html): Proven opening hooks for the first 3 seconds and clickable title ideas for Shorts and long-form videos.
- [Word Counter & Reading Time](https://websiteads.vercel.app/tools/word-counter.html): Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs, plus reading and speaking time.
- [Strong Password Generator](https://websiteads.vercel.app/tools/password-generator.html): Create strong random passwords with a live strength meter.
